description: This file contains implementations related to spectral operations in PyTorch, including FFT transformations, normalization, shape adjustments, and conjugate symmetry filling, primarily for spectral and Fourier transforms.

methods.name: promote_type_fft
methods.description: Promotes input scalar types to appropriate FFT types based on require_complex and device.

methods.name: promote_tensor_fft
methods.description: Promotes tensor dtype for FFT operations, optionally requiring complex type.

methods.name: norm_from_string
methods.description: Converts normalization mode string to enum value, considering transform direction.

methods.name: resize_fft_input
methods.description: Adjusts tensor shape by padding or slicing to match specified sizes.

methods.name: fft_r2c_maybe_out
methods.description: Performs real-to-complex FFT with optional output tensor.

methods.name: fft_c2r_maybe_out
methods.description: Performs complex-to-real FFT with optional output tensor.

methods.name: fft_c2c_maybe_out
methods.description: Performs complex-to-complex FFT with optional output tensor.

methods.name: fft_c2r
methods.description: Performs complex-to-real FFT, handling normalization and shape adjustments.

methods.name: fft_r2c
methods.description: Performs real-to-complex FFT, handling normalization and shape adjustments.

methods.name: fft_c2c
methods.description: Performs complex-to-complex FFT, handling normalization.

methods.name: canonicalize_fft_shape_and_dim_args
methods.description: Pre-processes shape and dimension arguments for n-dimensional FFTs, ensuring validity and defaults.

methods.name: fft_fftn
methods.description: Performs n-dimensional FFT for complex inputs.

methods.name: fft_ifftn
methods.description: Performs inverse n-dimensional FFT for complex inputs.

methods.name: fft_rfftn
methods.description: Performs real-to-complex n-dimensional FFT.

methods.name: fft_irfftn
methods.description: Performs inverse real-to-complex n-dimensional FFT.

methods.name: fft_hfftn
methods.description: Performs Hermitian FFT in n-dimensions.

methods.name: fft_ihfftn
methods.description: Performs inverse Hermitian FFT in n-dimensions.

methods.name: fft_fft2
methods.description: Performs 2D FFT.

methods.name: fft_ifft2
methods.description: Performs 2D inverse FFT.

methods.name: fft_rfft2
methods.description: Performs 2D real-to-complex FFT.

methods.name: fft_irfft2
methods.description: Performs 2D inverse real-to-complex FFT.

methods.name: fft_hfft2
methods.description: Performs 2D Hermitian FFT.

methods.name: fft_ihfft2
methods.description: Performs 2D inverse Hermitian FFT.

methods.name: fft_fftfreq
methods.description: Generates FFT frequency bins.

methods.name: fft_rfftfreq
methods.description: Generates RFFT frequency bins.

methods.name: fft_fftshift
methods.description: Shifts the zero-frequency component to the center of the spectrum.

methods.name: fft_ifftshift
methods.description: Inverse shift of FFT spectrum.

methods.name: stft
methods.description: Computes Short-time Fourier Transform for signal analysis.

methods.name: istft
methods.description: Computes inverse Short-time Fourier Transform to reconstruct signals.
